finding_reverification.rejected_detach: ADDRESSED: acquireSession.release caches its promise and throws when detach returns ok:false. detach keeps attached and lease-owned tracking after a rejected Chrome command, allowing the next scoped lease to retry. document-network-capture.close converts release failure into an unconfirmed-cleanup error; run-interactive waits for close before resolving rows. The saved UI test asserts no captured row and no health update on rejected detach.
finding_reverification.acknowledged_detach: ADDRESSED: successful detach clears attachment and lease ownership. A replacement acquire waits for detachPending before choosing its generation, then attaches anew. The same generation cannot be released twice.
finding_reverification.owned_borrowed_concurrent: ADDRESSED: lease counts defer owned detach until the final release; ordinary attach/send retains a borrowed attachment. Ordinary network and console capture now await pending detach before enabling CDP domains. An old detached lease cannot send through or release its replacement.
finding_reverification.finite_stall: PRESERVED: setup/reload and close remain bounded at the saved caller; a stalled hook removal or debugger detach returns an unconfirmed-cleanup error rather than resolving rows. A command Chrome never settles cannot establish actual hook or debugger release.
